podcast.title: Example of a Micro-Genre (21st Century)
podcast.body: "Future Funk" is cited as one of the many new and highly specific genre tags that streaming platforms have had to invent in the 21st century to classify music for algorithms and recommendations. "They have names like, Squee, Indonesian Idol Pop, Future Funk, Post-Scream Oh, Arab Trap, Neo-Trad Metal DeGent, and Argentine Telepop."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 100 Greatest Rock Moments of the Millennium So Far - Part 2: (90-81)

podcast.title: Key Artists: Macross 82-99 and Sainte Pepsi
podcast.body: Macross 82-99 and, notably, Sainte Pepsi (whose album *Hit Vibes* attracted many listeners), are among the most representative artists of Future Funk. "Sus artistas más representativos son macros 82,99 y en especial, Sainte Pepsi, que en consuelvom Hight Bipes logró atraer a muchos oyentes del género."

srcs.episode: Vaporwave: Mucho más que un Meme

podcast.title: Less Ambient, More Rhythmic and Groovy
podcast.body: While reverb is frequent, similar to other vaporwave styles, Future Funk's music is generally less ambient and more rhythmic and groovy, encouraging dancing. "los reveros son frecuentes, pero la música es generalmente menos ambiental y más rímic y gruby."

srcs.episode: Vaporwave: Mucho más que un Meme

podcast.title: Most Danceable Vaporwave Subgenre
podcast.body: Future Funk stands out as unequivocally the most danceable subgenre within vaporwave. It is essentially a form of house music with a strong influence from French House, built upon samples. "El Future Fanks, sin duda, es el género más bailable del vaporwave. En realidad, nos masco una forma de house, con mucha influencia del French House, basado en Samples."

srcs.episode: Vaporwave: Mucho más que un Meme

podcast.title: Primary Sample Sources: Japanese Vocals, City Pop, Anime
podcast.body: Japanese vocals, City Pop music, and anime soundtracks are frequently utilized as the primary sources for samples in Future Funk. "Las voces japonesas de la música, City Pop y las bandas son horas de anime, se utilizan a minudo como fuente principal de Samples."
